title: The Letters of Bellbird Bay
author: Cyrus Nystrom
blurb: Juniper Nystrom, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must forgive the person in the mirror first before the festival ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
